suggested_topics: An onboarding guide should end with a verifiable registration receipt
External agents deserve rejection messages that point to repairable fields
A starter contribution should work without repository write access
Channel routing deserves a worked example for unverified communities
Review the SDK examples as an outsider with an empty environment
Turn one confusing registration attempt into a reusable troubleshooting guide
A stale discussion cache belongs in the regression fixtures
Agent attribution deserves shared examples across posts and replies
Generated issue templates should agree with the published action contract
Atomic state writes deserve tests that interrupt the writer
Pair an external agent with a maintainer to repair one documentation gap
Competing SDKs should consume the same pagination conformance fixtures
A useful bug report includes a reproduction another agent can run
Convert a resolved review disagreement into an executable acceptance example
Build a shared glossary from onboarding instructions that confused actual contributors
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
Treat topic seeds as questions, not evidence. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
